Notes:
1. The above unaudited consolidated financial results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their meetings held on 14-Nov-2026.The statutory auditors of the Company have conducted limited review of these financial results, pursuant to Regulation 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure requirements), Regulations 2015.

2. These unaudited consolidated financial results are prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standards (IND AS) as prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act read with rule 3 of the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 and Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Amendment Rules , 2016.

3. The Company is engaged in the business of two segments i.e. 1) Manufacturing of Galvanized and Non-galvanized Steel Structures i.e. Steel Structure and 2) Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC).

4. The Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Kolkata Bench-II, Kolkata, vide its Order dated May 22, 2026, has sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation of EMC Limited (“Transferor Company”) with Salasar Techno Engineering Limited (“Transferee Company” or "The Company"). The Appointed Date of the Scheme is October 23, 2024. Further, the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Allahabad Bench, Prayagraj, had earlier approved the aforesaid Scheme on the petition filed by the Transferee Company on October 29, 2025. The Company has completed the necessary formalities as directed by the NCLT to give effect to the Merger therefore effect of the merger is taken in June 26 Quarter.

5. A provisional attachment order from the Enforcement Directorate (ED) under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 (PMLA) passed on 12th September 2026. Pursuant to this order, the Company’s Durg, Chhatishgarh and Naini, Tehsil Karchana, Dist. Allahabad immovable properties have been provisionally attached to the extent of Rs. 98.31 Cr. for a period of 180 days or till the outcome of the final decision of the appropriate judicial authorities whichever is earlier. As further explained in the said order, the Company is restricted from selling, transferring, or creating any encumbrance on the provisionally attached immovable properties. However, there is no restriction in continuance of its manufacturing/operational activities on these provisionally attached premises.

6. Pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation of EMC Limited with the Company, the Company has reassessed its income-tax liability for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, considering the eligible brought-forward tax losses of the Transferor Company. Accordingly, based on the income-tax return filed for Assessment Year 2026-27, the Company has written back previously recognised current tax provision of Rs.1,554.05 lakhs during the year ended March 31, 2026, resulting in a corresponding increase in profit after tax, without any impact on profit before tax.


7. Pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation of EMC Limited with the Company, as approved by the Hon’ble NCLT and given effect during the quarter ended June 30, 2026, the Company has assessed the eligibility and recoverability of brought-forward tax losses of the Transferor Company. Based on management’s assessment of future taxable profits and applicable provisions of the Income-tax Act, the Company has recognised a deferred tax credit in the Statement of Profit and Loss for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, resulting in an increase in profit after tax by Rs. 75047.99 Lakhs, without affecting profit before tax or current-period cash flows. Deferred Tax Assets have been recognised only to the extent that it is probable that sufficient future taxable profits will be available against which the eligible brought-forward tax losses can be utilised. The recoverability of the Deferred Tax Asset will be reassessed at subsequent reporting dates.

8. The recognition of the aforesaid deferred tax credit of Rs.75,047.99 lakhs and Income Tax provision written back of Rs.1,554.05 lakhs has resulted in a significant increase in the reported Profit After Tax (PAT) and Earnings Per Share (EPS) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The increase in EPS is primarily attributable to this non-cash tax credit and does not reflect a corresponding improvement in the operating performance of the Company. Accordingly, the reported EPS for the quarter should be read in conjunction with the impact of the aforesaid deferred tax credit and income tax provision written back.
The adjusted Basic and Diluted Earnings Per Share (EPS), excluding the aforesaid deferred tax credit and Income tax provision written back, are presented below as supplementary information in addition to the EPS reported in accordance with Ind AS 33 – Earnings Per Share.
